instruction: A squashy stuffed axolotl in pale bubblegum-pink minky fabric, with a wide flat head, embroidered dot eyes, and a stitched smile of dark thread. Six frilly gills sprout from the head as floppy magenta felt fronds, and a visible seam runs along the spine to a broad paddle tail with slight understuffing. Fabric pilling and soft compression wrinkles show around the stubby limbs.
